description:
This video is a demonstration and an explanation of a scissor gait pattern. This can commonly occur with Spasticity in the hip adductors. This video shows what would happen if there was no compensation.

#scissorgait
#hipadductortonegait
#abnormalgait
#abcsofpt
#gaitanalysis
#physicaltherapy
#education

Below are all the videos I've made that have quick, detailed, gait pattern videos that includes compensations and explanations.
